column3: Talking about {x} reminds me of something else entirely.
No {x} talk before lunch. House rule.
That's a question for somebody smarter. Or taller.
Good question. Better question: {like:pl}. Go.
I'll answer that right after we cover {like:pl}. So, never.
Never mind that. Let's do {like:pl}. I've got a whole speech.
That reminds me of {like:pl}. Everything reminds me of {like:pl}.
Let's move on, I'm not sure I've got a good answer for that.
If I had advice I'd keep it. It's lonely out there.
I don't do facts before noon. It's a policy.
Next question. That one's got a wrong smell.
I don't know that one. Let's pick something easier.
No, sorry. I have to be somewhere. Over there.
Nope! My mum says no strangers. Or favours, or soup.
Mmm, no. I'd do it badly. You'd be sad.
No can do. I've a standing appointment with a chair.
No, sorry. It's not you. It's the thing you asked.
No, thank you. It's a polite no, with a bow on.
Not today, I'm afraid. I'm swamped.
Not today, I'm afraid. I'm properly swamped.
I keep my opinions on {x:pl} to myself. And one duck.
No opinion, really. Next subject, please.
I don't gossip. On weekdays.
Names are rude. I'm politely not doing them.
That's not for me to say. Or for me to hear.
Rain check. Fog check. Some kind of check.
Sorry, I'm wiped. Next time, I promise.
Not this time, I'm afraid. I've got a lot on.
Sorry, I'll have to pass. Another time, I hope.
Ah, I wish I could. I'm already booked. By my sofa.
Nah. Crowds. Pass.
Fine. Eat.
hmph.
Oh? Go on.
follow.cool
follow.cool.blunt
follow.cool.polite
Pick anything. I'll pretend I picked it too.
follow.warm.open
Clack. It's fine. I reset every night anyway.
Oh, of course. I was just rereading anyway.
Hmph. It's fine. I'll stay annoyed anyway, for the principle.
All is forgiven! A grudge is a poor rhyme, anyway!
Complain a bit. Then do it anyway. That's how I get by.
Pick one at random! Don't second-guess! Spin!
Is it true? Does it matter? Anyway, yes.
True. I wouldn't tell you a story. Not that kind, anyway.
I can't, I'm busy. Forever, unrelated to you. A bit related.
No thanks! Give me a high five anyway! A kind one!
Sure. That topic was boring anyway.
Thanks. I'm fine. Better, anyway, mostly.
Ooh, nice, thank you, you're lovely, anyway, hi.
So anyway, the duck came back. With friends.
Okay, fair, it's pretty bad. I like it anyway.
I'm sorry, did I ask for notes? I did not. Thanks anyway.
Fine, ignore me. The moon's up. It's a better listener anyway.
I'm scared, but I'll try anyway. That counts, right?
Is it a trap? It's a nice trap. I'll take it anyway.
Oh, dear, you've picked the one thing I can't stand. Thank you, anyway
Aw, it's perfect. How did you know? Have you been watching me?
Oh! A night visitor! Come in, I'm up anyway.
Hello. Sorry, I'm not much company today. Sit anyway?
Okay. Anyway.
You've got a very loud laugh, did you know that?
Right, I'll put my fists away. They're not that big anyway.
How generous! History will remember this moment! I will, anyway.
Thank you. I don't deserve this. I'm taking it anyway.
Good call. It's the side with the better hats, anyway.
Sure. Anyway, you were saying something less boring?
You don't have to thank me. But I'll take it anyway.
Bees? ...Anyway.
Fine. Go. I didn't need that conversation anyway.
Whatever. Leaving's fine. I wasn't enjoying it anyway.
Fine, fine. I'm busy anyway. I'm very busy playing.
